strings.en: The fortress island... is going down...!
Burai's suicide charge was no match for our own charge...
Guess that's how it went.
That's the end of that.
Still, the Demon Empire, Campbellians, and Hyakki... Mostly handled.
True. But Koji...
I know. ...You mean Dr. Hell, right, Sayaka?
The Demon Empire, the Campbellians, and now the oni.
I'd say we've dealt with most of our enemies.
But Tetsuya, there's still...
Right. Dr. Hell, who Koji and I should have defeated...
It bothers me that Mykene, likely the one behind him, has been so quiet.
But Commander Hazuki said we're storming Jaburo next...
Isn't that fine?
That Dr. Hell guy got beaten once already by Kabuto and Tsurugi, right?
Guys who keep crawling back like sore losers can't be all that tough.
That's right. We gotta think ahead.
Well, yeah, I guess.
It's Jaburo, where we got right up to the door but never made it inside.
This time for sure.
I'd like to think so.
...I suppose right now we do have to think about Jaburo.
Oh, there you are. Hey, no time to gawk at the Hyakki floating island!
Looks like there are Hyakki and Campbellian robots south of Jaburo.
What!? What do you mean!? The Campbellians were definitely...
The fortress island's burning down right in front of us,
so it's hard to believe, y'know.
Anyway, please come up to the bridge!
Roger... I don't like this. The end's still a long way off, huh...
To think they would actually stop the colony.
And things on the surface are starting to settle... The time is right.
You called for me, Lady Haman?
The Federation is in chaos from the alien invasion.
Though we've been affected in no small way, too.
Mashymre, lead the new models and bring down Londo Bell.
Yes, ma'am! ...Lady Haman, what are your thoughts on the surface?
I could send men from my unit, and we could hit the Federation's main forces
on the surface and in space at once. That might prove amusing.
Fear not. I've already sent a unit to Jaburo. Glemy's.
Besides... there's an interesting one among the Titans' survivors.
The Titans...? No, more importantly, Glemy Toto...!?
Lady Haman, forgive my impertinence, but that man is...
...I know.
Pardon? Then why...?
I want to see it. How that one will move...
You need only devote all your strength to defeating Londo Bell...
I'm counting on you, Mashymre.
I'm unworthy of such words...!
On the honor of Mashymre Cello, I will surely live up to your hopes,
Lady Haman...!
Man, when that whole chunk of Kyoto got blasted all the way to the moon,
I didn't know what the hell we were gonna do.
A whole city, huh... The Meganoids' device is no laughing matter.
Yeah. They say it's not as powerful as before, but we can't relax.
Still, we got lucky.
We got sent over early, so Dr. Tarsan...
Oh, he's the doctor who built Dangaioh.
He sent us back with a warp beam.
Handy, though I'd rather not have been dumped right on the front line.
What're you talkin' about, Mike?
Thanks to that, we made it in time for the fight with the Hyakki Empire.
You sure surprised me, showing up out of nowhere.
Looks like it's chaos down on the surface as usual.
This is actually things calming down a bit.
And up in space, there's that plant planet thing showin' u...
Pai!
Hm?
Aw, crap, it slipped out. My bad!
I-It's nothing.
What is it? This plant planet?
Could it be there's a new enemy force in space?
Until a little while ago, it was just a small cluster of meteorites...
but it's been growing bigger and seems to be headed for Earth.
First a colony, now a meteorite...
Heh, how ironic...
While we stopped the colony drop, a plant planet was closing in...
Captain Bright seemed to have something in mind.
That's why he said not to tell everyone yet...
I see. Still, it might be best to inform Commander Hazuki...
Well, wasn't it fine to tell 'em about now?
Maybe so.
About this plant planet...
I truly apologize... Commander.
It's not that I was deliberately hiding it. It's just...
I understand, Captain Bright.
My concern isn't that you kept the matter quiet.
It's what this planet made of plants really is... and how we deal with it.
Quite right. I'll transfer the data to you.
There are no major problems so far, but it has certainly
attacked our survey team... with humanoid weapons.
What about the other enemy forces?
Most factions have quieted down, but we can't let our guard down yet.
We've also confirmed reports of new forces, like the Crossbone Vanguard,
who champion Cosmo Aristocratism.
New enemies in space, and the Hyakki and Mykene mechs we beat are
at Jaburo on the surface... I wonder how long our fight will go on.
No argument there. What a mess. Hm... We're nearing the combat zone.
Sorry, but I'll leave the Neo Zeon units that descended to you...
Commander Hazuki, I'm counting on you.
Leave it to us. And I wish you the best of luck, Captain Bright...!
Likewise to you.
At last...! At last... Heh, hahahaha... It's complete... My...
my child, Apsaras...!
Being complete doesn't mean it'll be of any use as a weapon.
Zabine! You have my gratitude.
With this... with this, I can finally show up those Federation dogs...!
Don't thank me... thank Iron Mask.
I've merely come to see how you are faring.
Heh, heh heh, heh heh heh heh.
Allow me to show you... the power of my Apsaras... Heh heh heh heh.
...So this is the completed Apsaras.
I see. No wonder Neo Zeon scrapped the project. What a hideous thing.
...In that sense, it's no different from Iron Mask.
I'll gather what forces remain and bring down Jaburo...!
Watch, Aina... Behold the power of my Apsaras...! Hahahaha!
We're finally going back into Jaburo.
Before that, we're to be resupplied at Kawasaki City.
I heard the Nadesico is in Kawasaki, right?
Yes, that's right.
And now the Nadesico is being formally assigned to the Federation.
What do you mean?
I don't know the details, but Nergal's goal is still retaking Mars...
the Scaparelli Project.
By formally joining the military, they can borrow its strength too.
That's likely Nergal's true intent...
So the Nadesico can't retake Mars on its own...
I believe we'll have to go to Mars ourselves eventually, but...
At present, Commander Hazard of the Mars Frontier Base
has been put on the back burner.
Besides, even if we're going to Mars, it's not like we can get there easily.
Couldn't we just get there easily with that Boson Jump thing?
Isn't a biological Boson Jump deadly to the crew inside?
Yeah. Seems a Federation ship's crew that Boson Jumped in the past
were all found dead.
Either way, it looks like going to Mars is a long way off...
Phew... Kurojishi's maintenance is done.
Good work.
Now we're all set to go back into Jaburo, Big Bro.
Huh? But we seem to be heading away from Jaburo...?
They said we're getting resupplied at Kawasaki City first.
When we reach Kawasaki, I'd like Maya's group to help load supplies.
We're short on hands, right?
When the loading's done, feel free to head into town and relax.
All right!
Then I'm going shopping!
I'll come with you.
(I think I'll try poking around Nergal...)
A warship's crew can't stay civilians forever!
Normally you'd all be sacked, but this time I, yes I, made a special effort!
For the sake of my Nadesico, I asked that you all be enlisted as soldiers.
Who asked you to?
Well, isn't it fine? We're fighting for peace on Earth, aren't we?
Admiral Munetake came here with that in mind, after all.
Then why not just keep working together like we have been?
The situation's different from before.
The military can't leave a warship like this alone forever, can it?
Even if you leave this ship, you'll only be put under unpleasant watch...
(Admiral Munetake... Who was it that suddenly called this man here?)
You can't just spring that on us out of nowhere.
You have the ability to protect the Earth...
The Nadesico is a ship that can make use of it. If you want peace on Earth...
if you want to free the people of Mars,
then you only have one choice, don't you?
What'll you do, Akito?
Huh? Me? Making war my job just doesn't feel right somehow...
Oh, not you.
Not me?
Right. You were only ever a temporary pilot,
and we can't leave an Aestivalis to an amateur forever, can we?
Then Akito can focus on being a cook...?
We don't need any extra cooks.
...So you're telling me to leave the Nadesico.
I'm telling you this isn't where you belong.
...Akito...
Megumi, you didn't have to leave the Nadesico with me...
What'll you do now?
...What about you, Akito?
Be a cook, I guess... But they'll probably call me a washed-up pilot...
I keep saying "I wanna be something,"
but in the end, nobody really wants me.
That's not true.
Exactly. What if we're the ones who want you?
You're just saying that so you can keep an eye on Akito!
Well? There's a job only you can do.
Only me...?
You know the Jovian Lizards use Tulips for a kind of teleportation,
a Boson Jump, to launch almost endless attacks, right?
What about it...!?
Nergal is rushing to crack that system, apart from the Federation.
What's that got to do with me...?
The Jovian Lizards are unmanned, and the Crocus's crew all died.
So why could only the Nadesico Boson Jump living things alive?
And so Tenkawa holds the key to that... is that it?
Banjo!?
Why are you here!?
We're here too, you know?
The Gandor's come to Kawasaki?
We just arrived a little while ago.
Figured we'd make the most of it and hit the town.
Anyway, I'd like to hear the rest of what you were saying.
The connection between Boson Jumps and Tenkawa, right?
Inez, you too? Why are you here?
She's taken an interest in our experiments.
These people want to make biological Boson Jumps a reality.
Send manned weapons to Mars or Jupiter, and the war would change.
The Jovian side hasn't succeeded in Boson Jumping living beings either.
We have to get ahead of them before they acquire that technology!
"Them"? You mean the Jovian Lizards?
...! Y-Yes, what of it?
Weren't the Jovian Lizards supposed to be unidentified?
That's right. Could it be Nergal knows something?
It's not like I know anything...!
You really don't know?
Even you can imagine that someone
must have built those unmanned weapons!
I don't know who they are, but am I not allowed to call them "them"!?
No need to yell like that... Sheesh.
Akito holds some clue to biological Boson Jumps?
B-But I shouldn't have any special powers...
No, you definitely have a mysterious power.
And Earth needs it.
Why Akito!? Akito's just a pilot!
Tenkawa, does this stone look familiar?
Wow! Isn't that a pretty blue gem?
It's no mere gem. This is... a fragment of a dream...
(I see... A fragment of a dream, huh?)
We call this "CC," Tulip Crystal. It was discovered on Mars...
So you've seen one...
It's just like the keepsake my dad left me... I lost it on Mars, though...
And? What happened to that "CC" of yours?
Huh... What?
These crystals are made of the same stuff as Tulips. My hypothesis...
"CC" triggers Boson Jumps! That day, you jumped, didn't you?
From Mars to Earth...
"That day"?
The day a Tulip fell on Utopia Colony on Mars...
(The day I couldn't save Ai... When I came to, I was on Earth...)
So that Tulip Crystal made Akito jump from Mars?
Yes, that's right... And the only one who can use it is you, Akito.
Even if you tell me that...
You've experienced a biological Boson Jump twice before...
The time at Utopia Colony I just mentioned, and the other day,
when you jumped the Nadesico from Mars to Earth...
(So a biological Boson Jump needs both CC and Tenkawa?
But why him?)
What!? An explosion!?
The Jovian Lizards!? What are they doing here...
Don't tell me they're after the Gandor and the Nadesico?
I wonder about that...
What do you mean?
Besides the Nadesico and the Gandor, wouldn't the Jovian Lizards
have something else here to target?
(Atomo Corp... Nergal after all...!)
